belongs_to: Opening problem: "Preetha and Adrit's grandmother made a quilt cover using old clothes. Now she wants to decorate it with lace. Tick the lace option that would cover the entire border of the quilt." (and "How much lace of each kind will be needed to cover the entire border?")
description: Picture of the quilt cover lying flat on the floor, drawn in slight perspective (the near side is wider than the far side), with the grandmother and two children sitting behind it (these three characters are decoration). The quilt is a rectangle of equal-looking patches (a patch is wider than tall in the drawing), 15 patches in every row and 10 rows = 150 patches, separated by thin dark seams. The 10 rows from the top (far side) to the bottom (near side) follow a fixed 3-colour cycle: row 1 green (dotted diamond texture), row 2 red (check texture with white lines), row 3 yellow (spiral texture), row 4 green, row 5 red, row 6 yellow, row 7 green, row 8 red, row 9 yellow, row 10 green (4 green rows, 3 red rows, 3 yellow rows; every patch in a row has the row's colour). A wide pink/magenta ruffled frill with a white wavy line surrounds the patch field on all four sides; this frill is the 'border' that the lace must cover. No length is printed on the quilt itself: the lengths along the border are the numbers of patches along each side, 15 on each long side (top and bottom) and 10 on each short side (left and right). The lace lengths are given by the three spools (next figure).
unclear: The 15 columns and 10 rows were counted from seam positions in zoomed crops (the picture is in perspective, so the near rows are wider); no number of patches is printed on the page.
The page does not mark whether the border to be covered is the edge of the patch field or the outer frill.

belongs_to: Opening problem, lace options: "(i) Red lace 40 units, (ii) Green lace 50 units, (iii) Blue lace 25 units" for the quilt border; then "She decides to use two different coloured laces. How much lace of each kind will be needed to cover the entire border?"
description: Column of three lace spools at the right of the quilt, top to bottom, each drawn as a round spool with a ribbon end unrolled to the left: (i) red spool, caption on two lines '(i) Red lace' (the word Red printed in red) then '40 units'; (ii) green spool, caption '(ii) Green lace' (Green printed in green) then '50 units'; (iii) blue spool, caption '(iii) Blue lace' (Blue printed in light blue) then '25 units'. The captions are printed to the right-below each spool. The only mathematical content is the three lengths 40, 50 and 25 units attached to red, green and blue.
